media.title: Kabarett der Komiker — illuminated advertising, Berlin, 1935
media.description: Night view of illuminated advertising for Kabarett der Komiker on Kurfürstendamm in December 1935. The photograph documents the cabaret’s later public presence and programme publicity; it does not depict Kaper’s July 1928 appearance or establish its venue.
media.altText: Black-and-white night photograph of snow-covered Kurfürstendamm with illuminated Kabarett der Komiker signs advertising Karl Valentin, Liesl Karlstadt, Trude Hesterberg and Maria Ney.
media.publicCaption: Illuminated advertising for Kabarett der Komiker on Kurfürstendamm, Berlin, December 1935. The photograph documents the cabaret’s later public presence.

places.authorizedName: Kabarett der Komiker / KadeKo, probable July 1928 venue: Haus Cumberland / Palmenhaus, Kurfürstendamm 193–194, Berlin-Charlottenburg
places.publicNote: Berlin cabaret venue connected with Kaper’s paid work as a pianist. A July 1928 programme lists Sula Lewitsch and Bronisław Kaper as “Jazz auf zwei Klavieren”; because the event predates the later WOGA venue, Haus Cumberland / Palmenhaus at Kurfürstendamm 193–194 is retained as the probable site.
